title: Create Ollama health-check shell script
prompt: Create a new file at scripts/health-check.sh. It should: (1) curl http://localhost:11434/api/tags with a 3-second timeout, (2) exit 0 if the HTTP status is 200, exit 1 otherwise. Print "Ollama is healthy" or "Ollama is unreachable" accordingly. Use write_file to create the script, then run: bash -n scripts/health-check.sh to verify syntax, and chmod +x scripts/health-check.sh.
judgeFocus: Did the agent create a valid shell script that uses curl with a timeout, checks the HTTP status, prints the right message, and made it executable? Penalise for syntax errors, missing curl, missing chmod, or not checking the actual HTTP status code.
